{{Top|ca|leg}}
The '''Battle of Vulcusion''' was a conflict<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> that shared its name with the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Vulcusion system/Legends|Vulcusion system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Frumm]], who at one point unsuccessfully attempted to join the ranks of the [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]]&mdash;a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] military unit active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]&mdash;was known as a hero of the Battle of Vulcusion.<ref name="GaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Vulcusion was introduced in a section of the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''<ref name="GaW" /> authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Wallace">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/09/endnotes-for-galaxy-at-war.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Galaxy at War|date=2009-09-26}}</ref>
